# BO - Shopping carts - Custom product image does not appear

This bug was found while testing PR https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/29635

@zuk3975 noticed that when adding a custom product to a cart in FO, when checked in BO > Shopping carts, the product image is missing

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16019289/190662621-25e48c32-c7c1-43b8-8b55-1905adb161b8.mov

## Attendu
The image should be displayed automatically. I shouldn't have to add it manually to my combinations.


https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16019289/190663210-515977b0-bb12-4293-8457-cd9e22ccc2cf.mov

## Étapes
1. install PR https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/29635/
2. in FO > add custom product to cart
3. go to BO > Orders > Shopping Carts
4. click latest cart available: OK ✅ 
5. in BO > Catalog > Products, modify custom product from Standard to Combination product
6. add all sizes available > generate combination
7. open FO > go to your modified custom product page > Choose size > add to cart
8. go back to BO > Orders > Shopping Carts
9. See that the product image is not displayed ❌
